title: Keeping AI Data In The US Costs 10% Extra
description:
Claude (US-only inference, 1.1x) and OpenAI (regional processing, +10% on eligible models) both charge ten percent more to keep requests in the US. A $2 model becomes $2.20. Sources: platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing, developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing
